state.description: the handwritten state name in the header

county.description: the handwritten county name in the header

sheetNumber.description: the sheet number in the header, exactly as written

enumerationDistrict.description: the e.d. number in the header, exactly as written

rows.description: every numbered person line on the main population schedule that contains any writing, including lines whose only content is an annotation such as a vacancy or callout note; skip lines with no writing at all

lineNumber.description: the printed line number of the row

name.description: the handwritten name exactly as written; when the surname position holds only a ditto dash, transcribe only the written given names; for annotation-only lines transcribe the annotation text; null if the cell has no writing

relationship.description: the handwritten relationship to head of household, e.g. head, wife, daughter, lodger; null if blank; when a value is struck through and corrected, transcribe only the final corrected value

race.description: the handwritten race code exactly as written; null if blank; when a value is struck through and corrected, transcribe only the final corrected value

sex.description: the handwritten sex letter exactly as written; null if blank; when a value is struck through and corrected, transcribe only the final corrected value

age.description: the handwritten age exactly as written; null if blank; when a value is struck through and corrected, transcribe only the final corrected value

maritalStatus.description: the handwritten marital status code exactly as written; null if blank; when a value is struck through and corrected, transcribe only the final corrected value

birthplace.description: the handwritten state or country of birth exactly as written; null if blank; when a value is struck through and corrected, transcribe only the final corrected value

occupation.description: the handwritten occupation text exactly as written; null if blank; when a value is struck through and corrected, transcribe only the final corrected value

industry.description: the handwritten industry text exactly as written; null if blank; when a value is struck through and corrected, transcribe only the final corrected value
